summary: The line pullback is compact and convex, and its two positive-volume endpoint fibers make it full-dimensional, so the one-dimensional rigidity fact applies and forces every intermediate fiber to have volume a with affine centroids. The selected 2M-1 lattice fibers, full masses, midpoint center, halfspace balance, and full-mass centroid metronoids satisfy every complete-core quantifier and give G at least (2M-1)a. Positive q-support places the child edges in a good parity class; the complete-product formula and A_f at most q_f at most r_f give the stated product-reservoir bound and its consequence. In the plateau specialization, divisibility and the parent congruence make both child half-indices integral, the endpoint ranges lie inside the flat block, injectivity gives the stated bound on |F|, and substitution yields exactly 128-320/(3N), at least 382/3 for N at least 160. The final K=4 implication and the stated flat-family-only scope are correct.
